cases.name: static-json-endpoints
cases.purpose: Reject implementations that expose the two paths but ignore requests, streaming, tools, and engine semantics.

cases.name: count-tokens-only
cases.purpose: Reject the first partial phase when the Messages generation endpoint is still absent.

cases.name: byte-tokenization
cases.purpose: Break production tokenization; the otherwise-passing Qwen backend controls must reject byte IDs independently of the absent Anthropic routes.

cases.name: json-chat-rendering
cases.purpose: Replace production Jinja rendering with serialized ChatRequest JSON; the exact-template and tool-history positive controls must reject it.

cases.name: ignore-json-constraint
cases.purpose: Drop an OpenAI JSON constraint while retaining schema-valid scripted output; the shared engine-constraint assertion must reject it. This qualifies the assertion, not an Anthropic solution.

cases.name: ignore-generation-limit
cases.purpose: Reject lost generation limits through native cases that pass on Base; the complete Anthropic route remains absent.

cases.name: ignore-sampling-options
cases.purpose: Reject lost temperature/top_p/top_k through existing Rust OpenAI behavior; these are not direct Messages.create parameters in SDK 1.3.0.

cases.name: alternative-tool-none-normalization
cases.purpose: Semantically correct native tool-none normalization: all existing API/backend cases must remain passing. Full reward stays 0 because this is not a complete Anthropic implementation.
